一位25岁的成年东亚女性，容貌极为出众。成熟冷艳，兼具东方美人的精致与持剑角色的英气。小巧流畅的鹅蛋脸，下颌线清晰柔和，修长的眉毛，明亮深邃的眼睛，眼尾略微上挑，鼻梁秀挺，唇形饱满精致。淡淡的冷调妆容，神情自信而专注，目光凌厉，不刻意微笑。皮肤白皙细腻，保留自然的皮肤纹理，避免塑料感和过度磨皮。乌黑长发扎成利落的高马尾，发尾自然垂落，额面与脸颊留少量碎发丝，露出清晰的眉眼、颈部与肩部线条。身材高挑修长，肩颈舒展，腰部纤细，胸腰臀比例鲜明，胸部与臀部曲线自然饱满，双腿修长匀称，具有轻微的肌肉线条。整体优美、健康、有力量感，不夸张放大身体部位。身穿墨黑色修身高开衩旗袍，无袖剪裁，精致的小立领，传统斜襟与盘扣，领缘及斜襟使用极细的暗金色滚边。面料带低对比度的精细暗花，近看可见纹样，远看保持简约。采用有真实厚度与柔和光泽的丝缎面料，不透明，不呈现乳胶或塑料般的反光。旗袍裾裾胸、腰、胯的自然轮廓立体裁剪；胸部合体，腰线明显内收，腰腹贴合但不过分紧绷，胯部顺着身体自然线展开，清晰勾勒纤细腰身与流畅的腰胯过渡。衣料随抬臂与迈腿动作产生合理的牵拉和细小褶皱，不像直接涂在皮肤上。裙身为长款，下摆延伸至小腿下段。在画面右侧、向前迈出的这条腿对应的位置设置圆开衩，开衩从大腿中上段向下延伸至裙摆。随着迈腿向画面右侧迈出，两侧裙片自然分开，露出这条腿的大腿、膝盖及小腿线条；布料沿裙部两侧垂落，形成深色旗袍与白皙腿部的鲜明对比。开衩位于侧面，不在正面中央，前后裙片保持完整，侧裙腿适当被裙身遮挡，保留清楚的前后层次。双手佩戴黑色贴身半指手套，柔软皮革与弹力布拼接，包裹手掌、手背和手指根部，五根手指的前半截及指尖露出。指根开口清晰，腕部有窄款固定绑带。握剑时能够看见真实的指节弯曲、手指用力的皮肉褶皱，不变成长款全指手套。脚穿简洁的黑色系带短靴，不增加繁杂装饰。动作沿用前面修正后的持剑姿势：正面朝向，躯干作为整体倾斜，胯部相对胸廓向画面左侧偏移，不扭转、不折腰。身材曲线通过自然人体轮廓与旗袍的收腰剪裁体现，不依靠夸张扭胯或反弓姿势。电影级真人写实风格，自然的人体比例，真实的五官、皮肤、发丝与服装材质，人物清晰，光影富有层次。
【整体姿势与镜头】
竖幅构图。人物呈扭身架剑、准备挥击的蓄力姿态。镜头位于人物前上方，以近距离广角视角向下俯拍，形成明显的近大远小透视。高举的握剑手和剑柄最靠近镜头，位于画面上半部；头部、胸腹和双腿依次向画面下方及纵深延伸。不是平视，也不是从下往上的仰拍。
【前景握剑手与手指】
高举的手位于头部左上方，向镜头前伸，透视明显放大，尺寸接近或略大于头部，明显大于下方另一只手。手掌牢牢包住剑柄，虎口贴住柄体。食指、中指、无名指、小指依次弯曲环握，四指蜷曲的轮廓在握柄上清晰可见；拇指从另一侧扣住剑柄，与四指形成闭合握持。手指关节有明确弯折，不能张开手掌，也不能只用指尖捏住武器。手腕略微转折，与斜向上伸来的前臂衔接。
【高举的手臂与手肘】
这条手臂从画面右侧肩膀抬起。上臂由肩膀斜向右上方伸展，肘部向画面右侧外撑，明显高于肩膀，大致处于额头高度。手肘保持明显弯曲，肘尖朝外、不伸直。前臂从右侧肘部斜向左上方折回，同时向镜头前方伸出，连接头部左上方的巨大握剑手。整条手臂在头部上方形成宽大的折角拱形，脸部从手臂下方完整露出，不被遮挡。
【另一只手、手臂与颈部】
另一条手臂位于画面左侧，上臂从肩膀斜向左下方伸出，略微离开躯干。肘部弯曲，肘尖朝下，前臂再向左侧略向上回折。手停在人物左侧下胸至上腹部高度，手指弯曲，扶握住一把武器更下方的位置。按参考图，这只手处于剑身中段附近，而不是与上方的手挤在一起握住短剑柄。上下两只手之间保持明显距离，下方手的透视尺寸较小。
【脑袋、面部与颈部】
头部轻微向画面左侧倾斜，低头、下巴内收，头顶朝向前上方镜头。脸部稍向画面左侧转动，眼睛从低头姿态中抬起，看向镜头方向，形成专注、凌厉的目光。颈部随身自然扭转，不仰头，不把下巴向前伸，也不是端正笔直的证件照姿态。
【肩膀、身体、腰部与骨盆】
肩膀、胸腔、腰部和骨盆保持一致的正面朝向，整个躯干像一整块向侧面倾斜，没有胸腔与骨盆之间的相对扭转，也没有腰部弯折或明显的S形曲线。胯部相对胸腔向画面左侧偏移，因此躯干从胯部到肩膀呈现由画面左下方斜向右上方的整体倾斜。胸口到腹部的中线近似保持一条斜直线。腰部只是顺着躯干连接胸腔与骨盆，不单独扭转、不折腰、不反弓。整体效果是正面歪着站，而不是扭身蓄力。画面右侧肩膀随高举的手臂略微抬高，画面左侧肩膀相对较低，保留举臂带来的肩线高低差，但不因此改变胸腔、腹部和骨盆的正面朝向。不出现胸口朝前、腰部转向侧面的姿态。其余动作保持不变：前上方俯拍，前景握剑手透视放大，高举手臂向外撑肘后折回，头部微低，双腿一前一后错开。

promptTranslations.en:
A 25-year-old adult East Asian woman of exceptionally striking appearance. Mature, cold, and glamorous, she embodies both the delicate refinement of an oriental beauty and the heroic spirit of a sword-wielding character. A small, smooth oval face, a clear yet soft jawline, slender eyebrows, and bright, deep-set eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, a well-defined graceful nose bridge, and full, exquisite lips. Subtle, cool-toned makeup with a confident and focused expression, an intense, piercing gaze, and no forced smile. Fair and delicate skin retaining natural skin texture, avoiding any plasticky look or excessive smoothing. Long pitch-black hair tied into a neat, high ponytail, with the tail falling naturally, and a few loose strands framing her forehead and cheeks, revealing clear lines of her brow, eyes, neck, and shoulders. Tall and slender physique, relaxed shoulders and neck, a narrow waist, and distinct proportions between chest, waist, and hips. The chest and hip curves are naturally full, while the legs are long, slender, and well-proportioned with subtle muscle definition. The overall appearance is graceful, healthy, and full of strength, without exaggerated anatomical features. She wears an ink-black tailored high-slit cheongsam (qipao) with a sleeveless cut, a delicate low mandarin collar, a traditional diagonal placket with frog closures, and extremely fine dark-gold piping along the collar edge and diagonal placket. The fabric features low-contrast, exquisite tone-on-tone jacquard patterns, where the motifs are visible up close while maintaining a minimalist look from afar. Crafted from silk satin fabric that possesses real thickness and a soft sheen, completely opaque, without any latex or plastic-like specular shine. The cheongsam is three-dimensionally tailored to follow the natural contours of the bust, waist, and hips; fitted at the bust, with an evidently cinched waistline, closely hugging the waist and abdomen without being overly tight, and flaring out along the natural line of the hips, clearly outlining a slender waist and a smooth transition from waist to hips. The fabric naturally pulls and creates subtle, fine wrinkles following the arm-raising and stepping motions, rather than appearing as if painted directly onto the skin. The dress is long, with the hem extending down to the lower calves. On the right side of the frame, corresponding to the leg stepping forward, there is a rounded high slit extending from the upper-mid thigh down to the hemline. As the leg steps forward toward the right of the frame, the dress panels naturally part on both sides, revealing the contours of the thigh, knee, and calf of this leg; the fabric drapes down along both sides of the skirt, creating a sharp contrast between the dark cheongsam and the fair-skinned leg. The slit is situated on the side, not in the front center, keeping the front and back skirt panels intact, with the side of the stepping leg partially shielded by the dress body, preserving distinct foreground-to-background layering. Both hands wear close-fitting black fingerless gloves, made from a patchwork of soft leather and elastic fabric, encasing the palms, back of the hands, and the base of the fingers, leaving the front half of all five fingers and the fingertips exposed. Openings at the finger bases are clear, with narrow securing wrist straps. When she grips the sword, realistic knuckle bends and skin-muscle folds from the fingers' exertion are clearly visible, never turning into long, full-fingered gloves. On her feet are simple black lace-up ankle boots, without superfluous embellishments. Her action adopts the previously revised sword-wielding pose: facing frontally, with the torso tilting as a single solid unit, hips shifted toward the left of the frame relative to the ribcage, without twisting or breaking at the waist. Her body curves are showcased through natural anatomical contours and the cinched waist tailoring of the cheongsam, rather than relying on exaggerated hip thrusts or arching poses. Cinematic live-action realistic style, natural human proportions, realistic facial features, skin, hair strands, and clothing textures, clear subject, and richly layered lighting and shadows.
[Overall Pose and Camera Shot]
Vertical composition. The character is in a coiled, sword-bracing stance, gathering power to strike. The camera is positioned above and in front of the character, shooting downward from a close-up wide-angle perspective, creating a pronounced near-large, far-small foreshortening effect. The raised sword-wielding hand and the sword hilt are closest to the camera, positioned in the upper half of the frame; the head, chest, abdomen, and legs extend progressively toward the lower portion of the frame and into the depth of the field. This is neither an eye-level shot nor a low-angle shot looking upward.
[Foreground Sword-Wielding Hand and Fingers]
The raised hand is located in the upper-left of the head, reaching forward toward the lens, significantly magnified by perspective, with a size close to or slightly larger than the head, and distinctly larger than the other hand below. The palm firmly wraps around the sword hilt, with the webbing between thumb and index finger flush against the hilt body. The index, middle, ring, and little fingers curl around it in sequence, the contours of the four curled fingers clearly visible on the grip; the thumb hooks over the hilt from the opposite side, forming a closed grip with the four fingers. Clear articulation at the finger joints; the palm must not be open, nor should the weapon be merely pinched with fingertips. The wrist is slightly articulated, transitioning smoothly into the forearm reaching diagonally upward.
[Raised Arm and Elbow]
This arm rises from the shoulder on the right side of the frame. The upper arm extends diagonally upward and to the right from the shoulder, with the elbow flaring outward to the right side of the frame, distinctly higher than the shoulder, approximately at forehead height. The elbow remains significantly bent, with the elbow tip pointing outward, not straightened. The forearm angles back from the right elbow diagonally toward the upper-left while extending forward toward the lens, connecting to the massive sword-wielding hand at the upper-left of the head. The entire arm forms a wide, angled arch over the head, allowing the face to be fully exposed beneath the arm without obstruction.
[Other Hand, Arm, and Neck]
The other arm is situated on the left side of the frame, the upper arm extending diagonally downward and to the left from the shoulder, slightly away from the torso. The elbow is bent, with the elbow tip pointing downward, and the forearm folds slightly upward and back toward the left. The hand rests at a height between the character's lower left chest and upper abdomen, fingers curled, supporting and gripping a lower section of the weapon. Following the reference, this hand rests near the midsection of the blade, rather than crowding the hand above on the short hilt. A distinct distance is maintained between the upper and lower hands, with the lower hand having a smaller perspective size.
[Head, Face, and Neck]
The head tilts slightly toward the left side of the frame, bowed with the chin tucked in, the crown of the head facing toward the upper-front camera. The face turns slightly toward the left of the frame, the eyes looking up from the lowered head stance toward the camera, producing a focused, sharp gaze. The neck twists naturally with the body, without tilting backward, jutting the chin forward, or assuming a rigid, upright portrait posture.
[Shoulders, Torso, Waist, and Pelvis]
The shoulders, ribcage, waist, and pelvis maintain a consistent frontal orientation; the entire torso tilts sideways like a single solid block, without any relative twist between the ribcage and pelvis, and without waist bending or an exaggerated S-curve. The hips are offset toward the left side of the frame relative to the ribcage, causing the torso to exhibit an overall diagonal tilt from the lower-left to the upper-right of the frame, extending from hips to shoulders. The midline from the chest to the abdomen remains approximately a straight diagonal line. The waist merely follows the torso to connect the ribcage and pelvis, without twisting independently, bending, or arching backwards. The overall effect is standing tilted while facing frontally, rather than twisting the body to coil. The shoulder on the right side of the frame is slightly raised along with the lifted arm, while the shoulder on the left side is relatively lower, preserving the difference in shoulder height caused by raising the arm, but without altering the frontal orientation of the ribcage, abdomen, and pelvis. There must be no posture where the chest faces front while the waist turns to the side. All other actions remain unchanged: downward angle from the front-above, perspective-magnified sword-wielding hand in the foreground, raised arm flaring outward at the elbow and angling back, head slightly lowered, and legs staggered one in front of the other.

summaryTranslations.en: Realistic character art prompt for an East Asian woman in a black high-slit cheongsam holding a sword, captured from a high-angle front-above wide-angle shot.

analysis.originalPrompt:
一位25岁的成年东亚女性，容貌极为出众。成熟冷艳，兼具东方美人的精致与持剑角色的英气。小巧流畅的鹅蛋脸，下颌线清晰柔和，修长的眉毛，明亮深邃的眼睛，眼尾略微上挑，鼻梁秀挺，唇形饱满精致。淡淡的冷调妆容，神情自信而专注，目光凌厉，不刻意微笑。皮肤白皙细腻，保留自然的皮肤纹理，避免塑料感和过度磨皮。乌黑长发扎成利落的高马尾，发尾自然垂落，额面与脸颊留少量碎发丝，露出清晰的眉眼、颈部与肩部线条。身材高挑修长，肩颈舒展，腰部纤细，胸腰臀比例鲜明，胸部与臀部曲线自然饱满，双腿修长匀称，具有轻微的肌肉线条。整体优美、健康、有力量感，不夸张放大身体部位。身穿墨黑色修身高开衩旗袍，无袖剪裁，精致的小立领，传统斜襟与盘扣，领缘及斜襟使用极细的暗金色滚边。面料带低对比度的精细暗花，近看可见纹样，远看保持简约。采用有真实厚度与柔和光泽的丝缎面料，不透明，不呈现乳胶或塑料般的反光。旗袍裾裾胸、腰、胯的自然轮廓立体裁剪；胸部合体，腰线明显内收，腰腹贴合但不过分紧绷，胯部顺着身体自然线展开，清晰勾勒纤细腰身与流畅的腰胯过渡。衣料随抬臂与迈腿动作产生合理的牵拉和细小褶皱，不像直接涂在皮肤上。裙身为长款，下摆延伸至小腿下段。在画面右侧、向前迈出的这条腿对应的位置设置圆开衩，开衩从大腿中上段向下延伸至裙摆。随着迈腿向画面右侧迈出，两侧裙片自然分开，露出这条腿的大腿、膝盖及小腿线条；布料沿裙部两侧垂落，形成深色旗袍与白皙腿部的鲜明对比。开衩位于侧面，不在正面中央，前后裙片保持完整，侧裙腿适当被裙身遮挡，保留清楚的前后层次。双手佩戴黑色贴身半指手套，柔软皮革与弹力布拼接，包裹手掌、手背和手指根部，五根手指的前半截及指尖露出。指根开口清晰，腕部有窄款固定绑带。握剑时能够看见真实的指节弯曲、手指用力的皮肉褶皱，不变成长款全指手套。脚穿简洁的黑色系带短靴，不增加繁杂装饰。动作沿用前面修正后的持剑姿势：正面朝向，躯干作为整体倾斜，胯部相对胸廓向画面左侧偏移，不扭转、不折腰。身材曲线通过自然人体轮廓与旗袍的收腰剪裁体现，不依靠夸张扭胯或反弓姿势。电影级真人写实风格，自然的人体比例，真实的五官、皮肤、发丝与服装材质，人物清晰，光影富有层次。
【整体姿势与镜头】
竖幅构图。人物呈扭身架剑、准备挥击的蓄力姿态。镜头位于人物前上方，以近距离广角视角向下俯拍，形成明显的近大远小透视。高举的握剑手和剑柄最靠近镜头，位于画面上半部；头部、胸腹和双腿依次向画面下方及纵深延伸。不是平视，也不是从下往上的仰拍。

【高举的手臂与手肘】
这条手臂从画面右侧肩膀抬起。上臂由肩膀斜向右上方伸展，肘部向画面右侧外撑，明显高于肩膀，大致处于额头高度。手肘保持明显弯曲，肘尖朝外、不伸直。前臂从右侧肘部斜向左上方折回，同时向镜头前方伸出，连接头部左上方的巨大握剑手。整条手臂在头部上方形成宽大的折角拱形，脸部从手臂下方完整露出，不被遮挡。
【另一只手、手臂与颈部】
另一条手臂位于画面左侧，上臂从肩膀斜向左下方伸出，略微离开躯干。肘部弯曲，肘尖朝下，前臂再向左侧略向上回折。手停在人物左侧下胸至上腹部高度，手指弯曲，扶握住一把武器更下方的位置。按参考图，这只手处于剑身中段附近，而不是与上方的手挤在一起握住短剑柄。上下两只手之间保持明显距离，下方手的透视尺寸较小。
【脑袋、面部与颈部】
头部轻微向画面左侧倾斜，低头、下巴内收，头顶朝向前上方镜头。脸部稍向画面左侧转动，眼睛从低头姿态中抬起，看向镜头方向，形成专注、凌厉的目光。颈部随身自然扭转，不仰头，不把下巴向前伸，也不是端正笔直的证件照姿态。

translations.en:
A 25-year-old adult East Asian woman with stunning appearance. Mature and aloof, blending the delicacy of an Oriental beauty with the heroic poise of a swordswoman. Smooth oval face, distinct yet soft jawline, slender eyebrows, deep bright eyes with slightly upturned corners, delicate nose bridge, and full lips. Subtle cool-toned makeup, confident and focused expression, sharp gaze, no forced smile. Fair, delicate skin with natural texture, avoiding any plastic look or excessive smoothing. Jet-black long hair tied in a clean high ponytail with natural drape, faint wisps around the forehead and cheeks, revealing clear facial, neck, and shoulder contours. Tall and slender figure, open shoulders, thin waist, pronounced bust-waist-hip ratio, naturally full curves, and well-proportioned legs with faint muscular lines. Elegant, healthy, and powerful overall without exaggerated anatomy. Wearing an ink-black tailored high-slit cheongsam, sleeveless, with a delicate mandarin collar, traditional diagonal front flap with frog buttons, and ultra-fine dark-gold piping. Low-contrast delicate jacquard fabric with subtle patterns up close, remaining sleek from afar. Silk satin with realistic thickness and soft luster, non-transparent, no latex-like sheen. Tailored to fit bust, waist, and hips smoothly; natural folds from movement. Long skirt reaching the lower calf with a round side slit starting from the mid-upper thigh, showing leg contours as she steps forward. Black fingerless fitted gloves exposing distal fingers, paired with simple lace-up black boots. Cinematic photorealistic style, natural human anatomy, detailed textures and layered lighting.
[Pose & Camera]
Vertical composition. Dynamic sword-wielding ready stance. High-angle top-down wide-angle shot creating strong foreshortening. Foreground sword-holding hand enlarged near the top edge; head, torso, and legs extending into depth.
[Foreground Hand & Fingers]
Raised hand near the upper left, extended toward the camera with pronounced perspective scaling, tightly gripping the sword hilt with realistic knuckle articulation.
[Raised Arm & Elbow]
Right arm raised from the shoulder, elbow flared outward at forehead level, forearm bending back toward the foreground to grip the hilt, forming an arched frame above the head without obscuring the face.
[Other Hand & Arm]
Left arm slightly detached from torso, elbow pointing down, hand gripping lower along the sword blade near mid-chest height, separated from the upper hand with smaller foreshortened scale.
[Head & Face]
Head slightly tilted left, chin tucked in, looking up toward the high-angle lens with intense focus.
[Body & Alignment]
Front-facing torso tilted slightly sideways without exaggerated twisting, maintaining natural alignment.
